en.description:
STOP GUESSING. START SCORING. DOWNLOAD FREE TODAY! 

SEE THE COURSE OTHERS CAN'T Most golfers play blind. GolfLogix gives you a complete 3D view of every hole, including elevation changes, landing zones, and green slopes, so you always know exactly what's in front of you before you pull a club.

HIT THE RIGHT CLUB, EVERY TIME No more second-guessing your yardage. Get precise GPS distances adjusted for slope, personalized club recommendations, and shot tracking that gets smarter the more you play. 

PLAN YOUR WAY TO LOWER SCORES See your shot before you hit it. Interactive 3D flyovers and your personal club distances help you choose the best strategy from tee to green, giving you confidence on every shot.

ATTACK THE GREEN WITH CONFIDENCE Know exactly where to land your approach. Color-coded green heat maps reveal slopes and contours so you can hit smarter approach shots and leave yourself easier putts. 

DRAIN MORE PUTTS Read every green like a tour caddie. Visualize the exact break, know where to aim, and step over every putt with confidence.

YOUR CADDIE ON YOUR WRIST With Apple Watch support, your GPS distances, hole layouts, and green reads are always just a glance away. Keeping you focused on your game without reaching for your phone.

SHARE YOUR BEST ROUNDS Share beautifully designed digital scorecards with friends, relive your favorite rounds, and track your progress every time you tee it up. 

TRACK IT. IMPROVE IT. SHOOT LOWER. Pro-level stat tracking shows exactly where your game is winning and where it's costing you strokes. Keep score for up to 4 players and watch your game improve round by round.

GOLFLOGIX APP FEATURES:
 - 3D hole previews & flyovers
 - Slope-adjusted GPS distances
 - Green heat maps & putt break reads
 - Personalized club recommendations
 - Digital scorecards for up to 4 players
 - Shareable digital scorecards
 - Shot tracking & advanced statistics
 - Apple Watch support
 - 40,000+ golf courses worldwide 

DOWNLOAD GOLFLOGIX FREE — SEE THE DIFFERENCE ON YOUR VERY FIRST ROUND.



PAYMENT INFORMATION GolfLogix is free to download with a Premium Membership available in Weekly, Monthly, and Annual plans. Try all Premium features free on your first 9 holes. Subscriptions are billed to your iTunes account and automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription in iTunes Account Settings.

For full terms and privacy policy, visit https://golflogix.com/Terms_of_Use.aspx
en.releaseNotes:
We've made several updates to improve your GolfLogix experience on the course, with enhanced course planning tools, expanded scorecard tracking, and improvements to the overall round experience.

Smarter Course Planning:

Club Landing Zones – Improved landing zone and club arc visuals help you understand your options and plan your next shot with confidence.

Scorecard & Round Improvements:

Expanded Stat Tracking – Additional scorecard stats give you more ways to track your performance throughout your round.

Scorecard Display Improvements – Updates make it easier to view and manage your scorecard while playing.

More Improvements:

Rules-Compliant Play – Continued improvements to support tournament and rules-compliant rounds.

Performance & Stability – Ongoing optimizations and bug fixes keep every round running smoothly.
en.subtitle: Range Finder,Scorecard & Watch
